item.title: Graphic Designer
item.description:
250-750 USD | I have just launched a small, fast-moving team and we need a creative partner who can own the full visual side of our first public touchpoint—our website.
The core of the job is Graphic Design, yet every asset you craft must fold naturally into an intuitive, web-friendly UI/UX. Think banners, icons, illustrations, color palette, typography, and then the actual page layouts that will carry those elements. We already know the site’s structure; what we lack is the look, feel, and polish that will make visitors trust us at a glance.
Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma or similar tools are fine—use whatever lets you move quickly while keeping layers, components, and styles editable.
Deliverables I need from you: • A cohesive visual style guide (colors, fonts, graphic motif) • High-fidelity mock-ups for the homepage + two key inner pages • Export-ready graphics (SVG/PNG) optimised for web performance • The working design file so we can iterate in-house later
I’ll provide the site map, copy, and a mood board on kickoff, and I’m happy to give rapid feedback along the way. If you can blend strong graphic aesthetics with user-centric web layouts, let’s talk and get this site live.

item.title: UI/UX Design Expertise Needed
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | # UI/UX Designer Required for Web & Mobile Applications
We are looking for a creative and experienced **UI/UX Designer** to help us design modern, clean, and user-friendly interfaces for our web and mobile applications.
The designer will work closely with our development team to turn ideas and requirements into practical, attractive, and easy-to-use designs.
## What You’ll Do
* Design modern and responsive website interfaces * Create mobile app designs for Android and iOS * Prepare wireframes, user flows, and interactive prototypes * Create high-fidelity UI screens in Figma * Design reusable components and maintain a consistent design system * Improve existing screens and user experience * Ensure designs work well across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices * Prepare development-ready design files and assets * Work with developers during implementation and provide design support
## Requirements
* Strong experience in UI/UX design for web and mobile applications * Good knowledge of Figma * Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design * Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and design systems * Good understanding of usability and modern UI/UX principles * Ability to create clean, professional, and practical designs * Good communication skills and ability to meet deadlines
## Deliverables
Depending on the project, deliverables may include:
* User flows * Wireframes * Desktop and mobile UI designs * Mobile app screens * Interactive Figma prototype * Design system / component library * Icons, assets, and supporting graphics * Developer handoff files and design specifications
## When Applying
Please include:
* Your UI/UX portfolio * Examples of web and mobile application designs * Your experience with Figma * Your hourly rate or project rate * Your availability * A short explanation of your design process
We are looking for someone who can work with us on the initial project and potentially continue with us for future design work.
Please only apply if you can provide examples of real UI/UX work you have completed.

item.title: WordPress Team Page Build

My site isn’t live or hosted yet; please build everything locally or in a portable way so I can drop it into hosting later. If you see a smarter presentation while developing, I’m open to ideas.
When you reply, include: • An estimated timeline with milestones. • Your total cost. • Any lightweight plugin or custom-post-type approach you plan to use to keep the page fast and maintainable.
All access you need will be provided. Looking forward to working together.

item.title: Elevate My Big Cartel Store
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | My Big Cartel shop is live, but it still looks and behaves like a starter site. I want to turn it into a polished, conversion-focused storefront that feels modern and clean, showcases sharper product images, works flawlessly on mobile, and ranks better in search.
Design & Layout – A fresh, minimal look that keeps the focus on the products. – Cleaner typography, consistent spacing, and an intuitive flow from homepage to checkout. – High-quality, properly sized product photos and gallery views that load fast yet stay crisp.
Functionality & Features – Smoother navigation so visitors reach any product in two clicks or less. – Smart extras such as variant selectors, quick-add buttons, and a streamlined cart. – Mobile-first responsiveness across all major browsers.
SEO & Marketing – On-page SEO: descriptive titles, meta tags, alt text, and logical heading structure. – Speed and image optimisation to improve Core Web Vitals. – Seamless integration of Google Analytics and social-sharing snippets for better tracking and reach.
Key Deliverables • Redesigned Big Cartel theme files or custom code ready to publish • Optimised product images supplied back in organised folders • A brief hand-off guide outlining any new settings, SEO tweaks, and how to update content
If necessary, I can provide current theme access, product photos, and branding assets as soon as we start. I’m open to your suggestions on additional tools or plug-ins that will help the shop grow, and I’m happy to review progress on a staging link before we go live.

item.title: Bold Landing Page Redesign
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | I need our existing landing page re-imagined from the ground up so it instantly communicates our brand story and raises overall awareness. The current version works, but it lacks the punch and clarity a bold, vibrant interface can bring.
My priority is a visually striking experience that respects usability: every colour choice, type scale, motion cue, and micro-interaction should guide visitors naturally through the page. While conversions still matter, the explicit goal for this project is brand awareness, so the final design must feel memorable and unmistakably “us”.
The areas that need the most attention are visual design, user flow, and content layout. Expect to audit the current page, propose an updated information hierarchy, and then craft high-fidelity mock-ups—ideally in Figma or an equivalent collaborative tool—so our dev team can implement without guesswork.
Deliverables I’m expecting: • A complete, layered design file with desktop and mobile breakpoints • Clickable prototype demonstrating the refined user flow • A concise style guide covering colours, typography, and key components for hand-off
Stakeholders are ready to review quickly, so clear rationale behind your design decisions and timely iterations will be key to moving this project forward. If transforming an ordinary page into a bold, engaging brand touchpoint excites you, let’s get started.

item.title: Shopify Product Store Setup
item.description:
3500-4000 USD | I’m building a new Shopify storefront where I’ll be selling physical products and I need an expert hand to get it launch-ready. My inventory is ready to upload, but I still need the site structured so shoppers can find what they want quickly and checkout without friction.
The most pressing task is creating 1–5 clear product categories (Shopify collections) and tying those into the main navigation. Alongside that, I’d like you to:
• Configure an on-brand theme, adjusting colors, fonts, and layout so the store feels polished on desktop and mobile. • Upload—or show me the best way to upload—my initial product set, making sure every item has optimized titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and SKU tracking. • Set up collection pages, menus, and filters so each of the 1–5 categories is easy to browse. • Run a quick checkout test to confirm shipping, taxes, and payment gateways are functioning correctly.
Acceptance criteria: the site should be publicly shareable (password removed), each collection must display the correct products, and the full purchase flow should complete without errors.
A solid grasp of Shopify’s theme editor, collections, and basic SEO is essential. If you can get this store ready for launch efficiently, let’s talk timelines and any assets you’ll need from me to start.

item.title: WordPress/Elementor & Local SEO Partner for Fitness Business
item.description:
3000-5000 CAD | We’re looking for an experienced freelancer or small team to improve our website and help turn online visitors into qualified inquiries, booked visits, and paying clients.
Business: High Octane Training — a fitness and training facility in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada Website: https://highoctanetraining.ca Platform: WordPress/Elementor, with links to Jane booking Engagement: Paid initial project, with potential for ongoing work
We want a partner who can identify priorities, explain their recommendations, and implement improvements. Experience with fitness, wellness, clinics, or other appointment-based local businesses is particularly relevant.
Initial project
Please quote for the following:
1. Assessment and priorities Review our website, mobile experience, navigation, local search presence, and inquiry/booking journey. Provide a concise action plan identifying the most valuable improvements and any important gaps we have missed.
2. Improve one customer journey Help us select one priority service or offer, then improve one existing Elementor page or create one landing page. Include layout, copy refinements, mobile design, and a clear inquiry or booking action, with two rounds of consolidated revisions.
3. Essential SEO implementation Implement relevant on-page SEO for that page: headings, metadata, internal links, and appropriate structured data. Identify wider technical issues and specify which fixes your quote includes.
4. Conversion tracking and reporting Review existing analytics and configure agreed tracking for the selected journey. Include social campaign attribution where appropriate. Explain what can be measured through our Jane booking handoff, distinguishing booking-link clicks from completed bookings.
5. Verification and handover Test the implemented changes, demonstrate the tracking, and provide a walkthrough of completed work. Recommend a separately priced plan for the next 60–90 days.
We will confirm the exact page, deliverables, access requirements, and acceptance criteria before starting.
Potential ongoing work
We would like the successful partner to provide or coordinate:
Elementor design, navigation, service pages, and conversion improvements.
Technical SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and useful content.
AEO/GEO: practical improvements for visibility in AI-generated answers, with a clear explanation of methods and measurement.
Funnels connecting search and social media to inquiries and bookings.
Appropriate lead capture and follow-up automation.
Reporting on qualified inquiries, bookings, and customer acquisition where data is available.
Website maintenance, performance, backups, and plugin updates.
Please distinguish essential work from optional services. Social content production, social account management, and paid advertising should be quoted separately if recommended.
Budget and working arrangement
Our target budget for the initial project is CAD $2,000, with proposals of CAD $1,500–$3,000 considered where scope and value are clearly explained. Please state your quote currency.
Following a successful initial engagement, we anticipate considering CAD $1,000–$2,000 per month for a defined ongoing scope. Ongoing work is not guaranteed.
Please propose manageable Upwork milestones tied to reviewable deliverables. Identify exclusions, recurring software costs, and assumptions that could affect pricing. Additional work must be agreed before it begins.
We will retain ownership and administrator access to our website, accounts, analytics, and completed work.
Who we’re looking for
Strong hands-on WordPress and Elementor experience.
Demonstrated local SEO and conversion experience.
Clear customer-facing writing and good design judgment.
One accountable lead, with disclosure of who performs each part of the work.
Reliable communication and availability for occasional calls during Toronto business hours.
International freelancers and small agencies are welcome. Experience serving Canadian or comparable English-speaking markets is valuable.
Your proposal
Please briefly explain your fit, link to two relevant projects, and outline your proposed milestones, timeline, and price for the initial engagement.
Relevant evidence and thoughtful questions are welcome. No unpaid custom audit or design is required to apply. We’ll ask shortlisted candidates to walk us through previous work.
We will choose based on relevant experience, quality, communication, and value. Please provide realistic expectations rather than guaranteed rankings or generic backlink packages.

item.title: Server for French Dinner Party
item.description:

Date and exact schedule will be confirmed once we connect. If you have relevant private-dining experience and can bring that restaurant-level polish into a home setting, I’d love to hear how you would approach the evening.

item.title: Youtube AI Summarizer & PDF Boost + Text Editor
item.description:
500-2000 EUR | I want to launch a full-featured web app that lets users: • paste a YouTube link and instantly receive an AI-generated written summary; • create or upload documents, enhance them as polished PDFs, and perform rich text edits (grammar correction, formatting tweaks, light rewriting); • pay seamlessly for premium usage and manage their own accounts.
Core modules I envision 1. YouTube Summarizer – Fetch video transcript automatically. – Run an NLP model (OpenAI, GPT-4, Grok, Claude to condense the content into concise paragraphs. – Display and let users copy or download the summary as PDF or plain text.
2. PDF Creation & Boost – Allow users to upload multiple files, merge them, add comments or highlights, then export a clean, share-ready PDF. – Support conversion from common formats (DOCX, PPTX, TXT) to PDF before enhancement.
3. In-Browser Text Editor – Offer grammar and spell checking alongside quick style presets. – Provide a “Rewrite” button that leverages AI to rephrase selected text while keeping the original meaning.
4. User & Payment Flow – Registration/login via email, Google, or GitHub. – Tiered subscription and pay-as-you-go credits handled by Stripe (or a comparable gateway). – Dashboard where users can view usage history, invoices, and saved files.
5. Admin Console – View metrics, manage plans, and moderate users or content.
Tech preferences – Modern front-end framework (React, Vue, or Svelte). – Node.js or Python back end with REST or GraphQL API. – Secure cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipeline.
Deliverables • Complete, well-documented source code. • Clean UI/UX that works on desktop and mobile. • Setup guide plus a short loom/video walkthrough. • Two weeks of post-launch support for minor fixes.
If you’ve built SaaS products that blend AI services with payments before, I’d love to see live links or repos. Let’s create something users will come back to every day.

item.title: AI-Powered Security Camera & Sensor Alert System (Prototype/Pilot Build)
item.description:
250-750 USD | We're building a pilot AI security monitoring system to replace traditional on-site guarding for sites such as depots, yards, commercial premises, and rural land.
We need a system that can:
Connect to IP/CCTV cameras (existing or freelancer-recommended hardware) and motion/perimeter sensors Use AI/computer vision to distinguish between people, vehicles, and animals — not just raw motion — to cut down false alarms Send real-time alerts (app notification, SMS, or WhatsApp/Telegram) when it detects a genuine event, e.g. a person on-site after hours Provide a simple dashboard or live-view where we can check camera feeds and recent alerts remotely Be built in a way that can scale from one pilot site to multiple sites later
This is a first pilot build — we want something working and reliable rather than over-engineered. Please propose your recommended tech stack (cameras, AI model/service, hosting, alerting method) as part of your bid, and break your price into phases:
Camera/sensor integration + live feed AI detection layer (person/vehicle/animal classification) Alerting + dashboard
Ideal freelancer: experience with computer vision (e.g. OpenCV, YOLO, or similar), IoT/camera integration, and comfortable working with a non-technical client to explain trade-offs (cost vs. accuracy vs. complexity).
We're a small UK-based team moving from traditional in-person security guarding into AI-led monitoring, so real-world reliability matters more than flashy features.

item.title: Engaging Startup Product Showcase Video (Not India, Pakistan, Bangladesh)
item.description:
5000-10000 USD | I want to create a polished promotion video that spotlights my US-based startup and the nearly 2,000 products we already carry. The piece is first and foremost a product showcase, but it also needs to hint at our brand’s personality so viewers instantly understand who we are and why they should care.
Visually, I’m picturing a seamless blend of live-action footage—think lifestyle clips, quick product demos, or behind-the-scenes shots—paired with clean animated call-outs, motion-graphics, and subtle text overlays that highlight features, specs, and pricing tiers. The storytelling rhythm should feel dynamic yet structured: short, punchy scenes that move quickly while giving each hero product its moment.
Here’s how I see the workflow: • Script and concise storyboard that decides which products (or categories) get screen time. • Live-action shoot or carefully sourced stock footage that fits our brand tone. • Custom 2D/3D animation layered over the footage for visual punch. • Professional voice-over, licensed background music, and tight sound design. • Final edit delivered in full-HD (4K preferred) ready for web, social, and trade-show screens.
I’m open on exact runtime and will lock that down with you once we have the storyboard, though it should stay short and engaging rather than sprawling. If you have a reel that blends animation with real-world footage, share it—seeing smooth transitions and brand-focused storytelling is key.
Let’s craft something memorable that convinces viewers our extensive catalogue is worth a closer look.

item.title: Independent HVAC Consulting Business Launch
item.description:
250-750 USD | # Digital Marketing / SEO / Lead Generation Expert Needed to Launch Independent HVAC Consulting Business
## Project Overview
PurAir is an established Texas HVAC company backed by more than 30 years of hands-on residential HVAC experience.
We are making a major business-model change.
**PurAir will NOT perform HVAC repairs, installations or equipment sales.**
We are repositioning the company as:
# PURAIR — INDEPENDENT RESIDENTIAL HVAC CONSULTING
Our customer is the homeowner—not the HVAC contractor.
We want homeowners to hire PurAir before making expensive HVAC decisions.
Our core message:
> **Before you spend $10,000–$30,000 on an HVAC system, get an independent expert opinion from someone who isn't trying to sell you equipment.**
Because we don't sell or install HVAC equipment, our recommendations can remain independent.
---
# Services We Intend to Market
Initial services may include:
### Independent HVAC Second Opinions
Homeowners who have been told they need an expensive repair or complete system replacement can hire PurAir for an independent assessment.
### HVAC Proposal / Estimate Review
Homeowners can submit one or multiple contractor proposals.
PurAir evaluates the proposed equipment, scope of work, sizing assumptions, duct modifications, warranties, and other important considerations.
### HVAC Quote Comparison
Homeowners receiving competing proposals can have PurAir compare the options and explain the differences in plain English.
### New-Home HVAC Performance Evaluation
Independent evaluation of HVAC performance in newly constructed homes.
Initial geographic targets include growing communities around Magnolia and Plantersville, Texas.
### Airflow / Duct / Humidity Consulting
Independent diagnosis and recommendations for comfort, airflow, duct and humidity problems.
### HVAC Replacement Planning
Help homeowners determine what type and size of HVAC system should be considered BEFORE requesting contractor bids.
### Ducted Inverter Heat-Pump Consulting
Specialized consulting involving 1-to-1 systems consisting of one ducted indoor air handler paired with one dedicated inverter outdoor heat pump.
### Generator-Compatible HVAC Consulting
Help homeowners understand HVAC electrical loads and appropriate equipment strategies when operating from standby generators.
---
# Local AND National Opportunity
We intend to initially establish PurAir locally in the Magnolia/Plantersville, Texas market.
However, we also want to develop a **national remote consulting service.**
A homeowner anywhere in the United States should eventually be able to:
**Upload HVAC proposals → Provide house/system information → Pay online → Receive an independent professional review → Schedule a video/phone consultation.**
Therefore, the marketing architecture should support both:
**LOCAL:** In-home consulting and HVAC performance evaluations.
**NATIONAL:** Remote HVAC proposal reviews, second opinions, and replacement consultations.
---
# What We Need From You
We are looking for someone capable of BUILDING the customer-acquisition system—not simply writing SEO articles.
Responsibilities include:
* Market and competitor research * Brand positioning * Keyword research * Local SEO * Google Business Profile optimization * Website architecture * Landing-page development * Conversion optimization * Google Search Console * Google Analytics 4 * Google Tag Manager * Google Ads * Call/form conversion tracking * Local geographic targeting * Lead tracking * Online booking/payment strategy * Review-generation strategy * AI-assisted marketing workflows
Experience with CallRail, Semrush/Ahrefs and CRM/automation platforms is preferred.
---
# AI EXPECTATION
We WANT AI used aggressively.
AI should reduce the cost of:
* Keyword research * Content development * Landing-page development * Ad variations * Competitor analysis * Reporting * Lead qualification * Email/SMS follow-up * Content planning
We are NOT interested in paying an agency thousands of dollars per month to manually perform work that modern AI tools can accomplish efficiently.

item.title: Shopify Store Optimization for Handcrafted alligator and cypress Goods
item.description: 2-15 USD/hr | About My Business: I run Pitres Handcrafted, faire etsy and .com selling 100% handcrafted goods, including hand-burned woodenware (like roux paddles and cutting boards), hand-stitched leather goods, and candles. Fix existing variant issues across all three platforms (Shopify, Etsy, Faire). I am specifically having trouble getting variants to sync and display correctly for items like my roux paddles. 2. Wholesale & Retail Integration Set up a B2B wholesale solution (like Wholesale Gorilla, Locksmith, or similar) on my Shopify store. I need the ability to manually approve wholesale customers so they can log in and see wholesale pricing, while regular retail customers see standard pricing on the same website. 3. item.title: Rustic Horse Boarding Website Integration
item.description:
50+ USD/hr | I operate a horse boarding facility and need a U.S.-based web designer to create a warm, traditional-yet-rustic online home that helps me attract new boarders. The site has to feel welcoming to equestrians while still handling the practical tasks of my business.
Core objectives • Seamlessly connect the website with our existing Facebook and Instagram pages so new posts and photos appear in both directions without extra work. • Offer an immersive, interactive facility tour—panoramas or 360° video—so prospects can “walk the barn” before they call. • Host legal boarding agreements in a secure, digital, sign-and-pay format. Once signed, the form should trigger an invoice through QuickBooks Online, allowing clients to set up monthly auto-pay for stall rent. • Provide a simple dashboard where I can publish or embed articles and videos—whether they come from my own content writer or trusted equine news sites. • Install visitor analytics (e.g., Google Analytics 4 with enhanced tracking or a comparable tool) and a Facebook/Instagram pixel so I can see who drops by even if they never fill out a form. • Build on a platform that lets me expand later with testimonials or photo galleries if I choose, without a full redesign.
Deliverables 1. Fully responsive website styled in a traditional, rustic aesthetic. 2. Integrated social feeds (FB & IG) with auto-sync capabilities. 3. Digital boarding agreement workflow tied directly to QuickBooks Online for invoicing and recurring payments. 4. Interactive 360° or video-based facility tour embedded on the site. 5. Content management area for articles and videos with copy-paste simplicity. 6. Visitor tracking setup with clear reporting instructions. 7. A brief hand-off guide or live walk-through so I can manage day-to-day updates myself.
I’m open to WordPress, Squarespace, or another stable platform—whichever best supports these functions without heavy custom code. Clean execution, clear communication, and an eye for country charm matter most to me.

item.title: WordPress Relaunch for Animal Welfare Site
item.description:

The donation page should also be redesigned to become a real donation landing page, explaining clearly what donations achieve and making it easy for visitors to support our work.
We are looking specifically for a freelancer with:
- Strong WordPress and Elementor experience - Experience with NGO, nonprofit or charity websites - Good UI/UX and web design skills - Experience with German or European clients - Responsive/mobile design experience - Basic SEO and performance optimization - Ability to work with our existing WordPress website - Ability to create a homepage mockup before full implementation
We prefer an individual freelancer or very small team rather than a large agency.
Please provide 2–3 examples of NGO/nonprofit websites and, if possible, websites created for German or European clients.
